text:
Marta: Quick design review — I pushed a new mock for the timeline: per-variant foldout that shows live metrics, allocation slider, and a small actions menu. asking: how's keyboard & SR behavior here? Sam: saw it, nice. my first thought: it's pretty dense when expanded. can we compress the metrics into a summary row + reveal more? Alex: +1 on density. also screen readers won't like 'foldout' as an affordance name — suggest use 'Details for Variant {name}' in aria-labels. Jordan: for rollback language, current 'Rollback to previous' reads scary for PMs. propose 'Revert to previous stable version' or 'Switch to previous stable' — calmer. Casey: can we show a tiny impact estimate in the header (e.g., "~1.2% error increase") when we have evals? helps people decide before rolling back. aria-bot: Accessibility checklist ping: role=button on the expand control, aria-expanded toggles, focus visible on keyboard, ensure the slider has aria-valuenow and an accessible label, and don't trap focus inside the foldout. Sam: adding a small code snippet we used elsewhere for the slider aria props: ```html
``` Alex: also recommend announcing on expand: "Variant A details expanded — allocation 10 percent, metrics updated" so screen reader users get the key info without digging. Marta: about visual layout: what if we move the allocation slider to the left of the variant pill so the timeline width doesn't jump when you expand? keeps the primary timeline stable. Jordan: mobile concern — foldout could push the timeline horizontally. propose the foldout overlay (modal-ish) on small screens rather than expanding inline. Casey: microcopy options for the rollback CTA: 1) "Revert to previous stable" 2) "Fallback to vX.Y" 3) "Stop rollout and revert" — I prefer 1 for clarity. Sam: reaction: :thumbsup: on option 1. also change iconography: the stop square feels aggressive, change to "rollback" arrow + text. Alex: can we show a confirmation step that surfaces estimated user impact and a link to recent errors? small step reduces panic clicks. Marta: agree. keep confirmation compact — don't block the flow. maybe an inline confirm with bolded impact line. Jordan: keyboard nav proposal: tab order -> variant pill -> expand button -> allocation slider -> actions menu -> confirm button. This keeps primary controls predictable. Casey: I'll draft updated copy and a11y hints and drop them into the Figma comments. Marta: thanks — I'll update the prototype: change text to "Details for Variant {name}", swap stop -> rollback icon + label "Revert", add SR announcement, and set mobile overlay behavior. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/canary-foldout-v2 Sam: quick QA note: when collapsed, ensure the collapsed summary row includes at-a-glance metric (latency, error rate) so PMs can scan. Alex: one more nit — the timestamp label in the foldout header should read "last 5m" rather than "5m" for clarity with screen readers. Marta: all good. plan: Casey handles copy + aria strings, Sam handles condensed metrics layout, Alex does SR announcement wording, Jordan handles mobile overlay, I'll ship updated figma and assign to eng sync for feasibility. target: small A/B on 10% traffic next week. Casey: assigning to myself. will post copy options by EOD. Jordan: remote ack, will pair with eng on overlay feasibility. aria-bot: Reminder: attach accessibility test checklist to the PR and include voiceover test notes. Marta: great work team — will follow up after copy landed. :rocket:
